message: 悪いのは誰？

name: Synn
message: 「So, that's why Azel is in a pinch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Put the camera away!」

name: Azel
message: 「Do something about this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Watch how you phrase things......」

name: Helena
message: 「Nothing can be done.」

name: Azel
message: 「You are the chairwoman. The highest authority in this academy. You should be able to do whatever you want.」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan. I think you should imagine what I might think of you when you address me so rudely.」

name: Azel
message: 「The meaning gets across.」

name: Helena
message: 「It has been posted up continuously since Monday of last week. Nothing can be done about it now.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you telling me to bow my head.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, I didn't say anything of the sort.」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone except Azel-chan has already completed the procedure. I cannot bend the rules that everyone else follows for a single violator.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault!」
I bowed my head deeply.

name: Azel
message: 「W-Why are you apologizing!」

name: Synn
message: 「If I hadn't dragged Azel into Student Council activities, this wouldn't have happened! It's my fault!」

name: Azel
message: 「No, you're wrong, Synn Sakura isn't at fault! I simply--」

name: Helena
message: 「She didn't look like she was participating very enthusiastically, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! For the upcoming Holy Night Festival, Azel is carrying out a big project to take photos of every student in the academy and put them on display!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's participating actively!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I'm being active about it or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel was the one who stepped up and suggested this kind of project!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's been sorting through all the photos she's taken so far to pick the best ones, checking out photo books in the library for inspiration--」

name: Synn
message: 「And walking all over the academy looking for even better photo ops--she's been super busy!」

name: Synn
message: 「So it couldn't be helped that she forgot to check the bulletin board!」
I looked straight at Helena-san.

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, it's Synn-chan's fault, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, it is.」

name: Helena
message: 「Then I'll just have to make Synn-chan take responsibility. Let's see--」

name: Azel
message: 「No!」

name: Azel
message: 「I am at fault. It is because I failed to look at the bulletin board. Synn Sakura is not to blame.」

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, it's Azel-chan's fault, isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is correct.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true.」

name: Azel
message: 「Enough. I know you are trying to look out for me. However, this is my fault. Therefore, I must be the one to take responsibility.」
Azel bowed deeply to Helena-san.

name: Azel
message: 「Ch... Chairwoman. My carelessness is the sole cause of all this. I-I am sorry.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, I'll be looking forward to the photo exhibition at the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Azel
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「You got so absorbed in your Student Council activities that you missed the notice, didn't you? In that case, see it through to the very end. That's how you should take responsibility.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll see what I can do about getting you a room on my end.」

name: Melilot
message: 「How are you finding it to use?」
Melilot-san asked as she served us black tea.

name: Azel
message: 「A trivial matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you stayed up all night reading the reference manuals the night you got the camera.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe. Best of luck.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not like--」
Azel started to say something, only to end up muttering bashfully.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's hard.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. Though it seems some people say that's the charm of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel's been so excited since yesterday, it's been a handful.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... Don't tell her that.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, well, that certainly makes giving it to you worthwhile.」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you have it repaired before giving it to me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you really sure about this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course. I don't use it anymore, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Cameras like this stop working if they aren't well cared for, right? This one works properly. That means it was cherished.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it really okay for me to have it?」
Taking the seat across from Azel, Melilot spoke in a gentle voice,

name: Melilot
message: 「Photography isn't really a hobby of mine. To me, it's merely a recording device, and lately I've been using digital cameras almost exclusively.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, I think the Leica would be happier being used by someone who loves it as a camera.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'll take good care of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is keeping records a hobby of yours?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Rather than a hobby... I suppose you could say I come from a long line of people who love recording things.」
